name: GeoSphere Austria TAWES station observations, 10-minute (Dataset API)
short: Austrian weather station readings every 10 minutes from GeoSphere Austria. CC BY 4.0, no key.
summary: GeoSphere Austria's Dataset API serves the TAWES automatic station network at dataset.api.hub.geosphere.at/v1/station/current/tawes-v1-10min. A keyless GET for station 11035 (Vienna) with parameters TL (air temperature) and FF (wind speed) on 2026-11-07 returned a GeoJSON feature stamped 2026-11-07T19:20Z with 2.1 C and 1.0 m/s. The metadata endpoint lists 288 stations and 53 parameters at 10-minute frequency, including wind direction and gusts. The same API serves other datasets (history, forecasts, grids); only this current-station product was tested.

tasks: latest 10-minute weather reading at an Austrian station (temperature, wind and more)
station list and parameter list for the TAWES network

coverage.notes: 288 stations per the metadata call, 53 parameters. Station ids are GeoSphere's own.

delivery.basis: Live GET 2026-11-07: reading stamped 19:20Z returned in a call made at about 19:25Z.

licensing.summary: The Dataset API documentation (License section) states that all data publicly accessible without authentication are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; no authentication is required. Credit GeoSphere Austria. AI training is not addressed.

time.method: Each record carries its own timestamp.
time.unknown: Timestamp is the provider's own stamp.

location.method: Fixed station or event coordinates in the feed.

content.method: Official network readings with units in the response.
content.unknown: No quality flags appeared in the response; processing is not described on the pages read.

human.unknown: Not applicable: automated instruments or official analysis, not people.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation from instrument to API is documented.

camera.unknown: Not applicable: no camera frames in this feed.

corroboration.unknown: Nothing documented independently confirms individual readings.

endpoints.notes: Call made. GeoJSON; omit station_ids for all.

api.rate_limits: Documented: 5 requests per second and 240 requests per hour per user; 429 when exceeded; response headers show remaining quota.
api.notes: JSON GeoJSON or CSV; request size limit of 1,000,000 values.
